title: Question 14
passage:
Will I have to pay a late fee if I return this book on Thursday?
A. The return slot is next to the side door. B. No, the book isn't due until Friday. C. You can check out up to six books at a time.
passageZh:
如果我星期四還這本書，要付逾期費嗎？
A. 還書口在側門旁邊。
B. 不會，這本書到星期五才到期。
C. 你一次最多可以借六本書。
